sloka: तपसा संभृते च एते बहु रूपे भविष्यतः ।ततो रामो जलम् स्पृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्ट वदनः शुचिः ॥१-२२-२०॥
transliteration: tapasā saṁbhṛte ca ete bahu rūpe bhaviṣyataḥ ।tato rāmo jalam spṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭa vadanaḥ śuciḥ ॥1-22-20॥

translations.english: Thereafter Rama, touched the water and was sanctified. With a cheerful face he received those two sciences from the maharshi who had perceived the supreme soul.
